definition: Implementation Profile of the operation Convex hull, whose meaning is its activity type (activityType): the signature of the Generic Profile Unary geometry operation, bound to data exchange formats.

hasAction.description: The meaning of the operation moves to the activity type https://w3id.org/geolabs/ospd/generic-profiles/activity-type/convex-hull, linked by activityType (gp:activityType). The definition no longer defines the operation; it was: "Returns a geometry that represents the convex hull of this Geometry."

The keyword ST_ConvexHull becomes an altLabel of the activity type; the sources defining the operation move to the activity type: OGC 99-049 OpenGIS Simple Features Specification For SQL, Revision 1.1, §2.1.1.3 ConvexHull(); ISO/IEC 13249-3:2016 SQL multimedia and application packages -- Part 3: Spatial, ST_ConvexHull.

The schema copied on each input and output that had one is replaced by the representation that realizes its data type in the data-formats register (decision D6): inputs/geometry -> geometry-gml (schema was {"type": "string", "contentMediaType": "text/xml", "description": "GML"}); outputs/result -> geometry-gml (schema was {"type": "string", "contentMediaType": "text/xml", "description": "GML"}).

Decision D4: 2 format keywords removed from inputs and outputs (inputs/geometry: GML; outputs/result: GML); sources removed (tools, testbed, the bbox schema now in the representation's format): ZOO-Project Geonovum testbed -- ConvexHull: Compute convex hull. <https://host1.tb.geonovum.geolabs.fr/ogc-api/processes/ConvexHull>; description rewritten without tool, host or testbed. Each removed tool or testbed reference remains findable at tier 4, in bblocks-process-profiles.

Corrects what https://w3id.org/geolabs/ospd/generic-profiles/implementation-profile/convex-hull/actions/tools-2026-11-09 describes: the description sections removed then (sources, illustrations, data formats, multiplicity and the open question where present, and the Register position reference to the tier-4 process and its testbed URL) are restored. Tools and testbed stay in the prose; decision D4 applies to the model (keywords, source, properties), which carries none. Decision of 2026-11-09.

The object identifier of this item moves from https://geolabs.github.io/bblocks-generic-profiles/def/implementation-profile/convex-hull to https://w3id.org/geolabs/ospd/generic-profiles/implementation-profile/convex-hull, which resolves through w3id.org (decision of 2026-11-17); the register actions of the item move with it, under https://w3id.org/geolabs/ospd/generic-profiles/implementation-profile/convex-hull/actions/. The old IRI is kept as owl:sameAs. The content of the item is unchanged. Classified clarifying: the item is the same, only its identifier changes.
